_meta.note: Recorded by the in-product frame recorder (KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES) while the real `kirocrew chat -m` CLI ran one turn on an isolated KIROCREW_HOME with agent.acp_backend=pi and agent.model=amazon-bedrock/amazon.nova-micro-v1:0 (pi's built-in amazon-bedrock provider): Kiro Crew's own AcpClient and PiLaunch, pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.4.0 (the lane pin, npm ci in test/real_adapters), the gate extension loaded through the gate launcher, inside the namespace sandbox backend the recording host provides. No AWS credential was reachable (AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true, AWS_CONFIG_FILE and AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE pointing at empty files, AWS_PROFILE=default so pi lists the provider), so pi's assistant message ended stopReason error, errorMessage 'Could not load credentials from any providers' (pi's own session file). pi-acp forwards nothing of that call; the gate extension recorded it at turn_end and, at agent_settled, notified the model-error envelope (kiro-crew-model-error, the gate nonce, provider, model, error), forwarded by pi-acp as an agent_message_chunk carrying _meta.piAcp.notify level error; the same session/prompt then ended end_turn, and AcpClient failed the turn with the envelope's failure line. The same drive before the extension reported it carried no chunk at all between the two session_info_update frames: an empty reply on end_turn. Reductions: 4 configOptions/models select(s) cut to the one option naming its current value: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 2 frame(s) dropped: the available_commands_update (the recording host's command inventory) and pi's startup-banner agent_message_chunk, whose text (and session/new's _meta.piAcp.startupInfo, set to null) is pi's own update check; the session id is replaced with the synthetic pi-session-1.
